Wrong: indexes are still valid, that isn't the issue.
Wrong: Kafka consumption speed isn't a direct consequence of this design.
scenario: sliding 窗口最长要支持「最近一月」，且每分钟都要更新时/天/月三张窗口表。
scenario_en: The sliding design must stretch to a last-month window and update the hour, day, and month tables every single minute.

q: 在「写入模式」这个维度上，tumbling 与 sliding 的窗口聚合方案差别是？
q_en: How do tumbling and sliding window aggregations differ in write pattern?
options: 两者都是只插入
tumbling 要读-改-写，sliding 只插入
两者都要读-改-写
tumbling 插入；sliding 读改写更重
why: tumbling 每小时插入一批新聚合行即可；sliding 每分钟都要读旧数据做减法再更新——这是 sliding 贵的根源。
why_en: Tumbling aggregation mostly inserts new rows while sliding aggregation must read the expiring slice and update in place, which is far heavier on the database.
options_en: Both are insert-only.
Tumbling needs read-modify-write while sliding is insert-only.
Both need read-modify-write.
Tumbling just inserts; sliding's read-modify-write is heavier.
optionExplanations: 错。sliding 需要读减量，不是纯插入。
错。这把两者的模式完全说反了。
错。tumbling 基本不需要先读旧值再改。
对。tumbling 只插入；sliding 要先读减量再更新，重得多。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong: sliding needs to read a decrement first, it isn't pure inserts.
Wrong: this reverses the actual pattern of the two.
Wrong: tumbling generally doesn't need to read old values before writing.
Correct: tumbling just inserts; sliding must read the decrement first, a much heavier pattern.
tradeoff: tumbling 纯插入低成本 vs sliding 读改写高新鲜度
scenario: 同一套聚合表，一边要支撑整点边界的 tumbling 榜单，一边要支撑连续移动的 sliding 窗口。
scenario_en: The same aggregate tables have to serve both tumbling leaderboards aligned to clock boundaries and continuously moving sliding windows.

scenario: 全窗口支持 sliding 代价巨大。产品上小时榜需要新鲜，月榜本来变化就慢。你想向面试官提出一个务实的折中。
scenario_en: Supporting sliding semantics for every window is expensive; users expect the hourly chart to be fresh, while the monthly chart naturally changes slowly.
q: 成熟的提议是？
q_en: What pragmatic compromise should we propose?
options: 所有窗口都用 sliding，保证一致体验
所有窗口都用 tumbling，保证实现简单
小时用 sliding，天/月用 tumbling
干脆砍掉窗口功能
why: 用户不期待月榜快速变动，但期待小时榜跟得上当下；按窗口混合语义砍掉了大头成本。主动提出这类折中是成熟度信号。
why_en: Propose sliding semantics only for the last hour and tumbling for day and month, matching how quickly users expect each leaderboard to change.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品硬性要求所有窗口都是精确滑动语义（例如按滑动窗口计费），就得上双消费组或 Flink 方案硬啃。
options_en: Use sliding for every window to keep experience consistent.
Use tumbling for every window to keep implementation simple.
Sliding for the hour window, tumbling for day and month.
Just cut the windowing feature entirely.
optionExplanations: 错。全都上 sliding 会把最贵的成本摊到所有窗口。
错。全都用 tumbling 会牺牲小时榜该有的新鲜度。
对。按窗口混合语义，砍掉大部分成本又不伤用户体验。
错。砍功能放弃了产品需求，不是折中方案。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong: making every window sliding spreads the most expensive cost across all of them.
Wrong: making every window tumbling sacrifices the freshness an hourly leaderboard needs.
Correct: mixing semantics per window cuts most of the cost without hurting user experience.
Wrong: cutting the feature abandons the product requirement instead of compromising.
tradeoff: 按窗口混合新鲜度语义 vs 全窗口统一精确滑动

scenario: 不想在数据库里保留一个月的分钟级明细，但滑动窗口仍需要减量数据。Kafka topic 的保留期可以配置得很长。
scenario_en: You do not want to keep one month of minute-level detail in the database, but sliding windows still need subtractive data and the Kafka topic can have long retention.
q: 巧妙的替代方案是？
q_en: What is the clever alternative for subtracting expired events?
options: 用第二个滞后 Kafka 消费组做减量
把分钟明细归档到对象存储
每天用批处理全量重算
用数据库触发器自动做减法

whenOtherWins: 如果 Kafka 保留一个月的存储成本不可接受、或不允许改 topic 保留策略，就退回「数据库保留明细」的方案。
options_en: Use a second, lagging Kafka consumer group to produce decrements.
Archive the minute-level detail to object storage.
Fully recompute everything in a daily batch job.
Use a database trigger to subtract automatically.
optionExplanations: 对。滞后消费组重放过期事件做减量，数据库不用存明细。
错。归档到对象存储仍需要额外读取和管理，没有省事。
错。全量重算的延迟远超几十毫秒的读 SLA。
错。数据库触发器无法感知『事件已滑出窗口』这个时间语义。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: a lagging consumer group replays expired events as decrements, so the database skips storing detail.
Wrong: archiving to object storage still needs extra reads and management, no real savings.
Wrong: a full daily recompute is far slower than the tens-of-milliseconds read SLA.
Wrong: a database trigger can't sense the time semantics of 'this event slid out of the window.'
tradeoff: 借助 Kafka 保留期重放减量 vs 数据库自留分钟级明细

q: 为什么不直接用 Flink 原生 sliding window（1 分钟滑动步长、最大 1 个月窗口）？
q_en: Why not directly use Flink native sliding windows with a one-minute slide and a one-month window?
options: 会产生 43,200 个重叠窗口状态，内存不可行
这个流处理引擎根本不支持 sliding window
会导致事件丢失
只支持一个窗口种类

options_en: It produces 43,200 overlapping window states, infeasible on memory.
This stream engine doesn't support sliding windows at all.
It would cause events to be lost.
It only supports one kind of window.

q: Count-Min Sketch（CMS）的工作原理是？
q_en: How does Count-Min Sketch (CMS) work?
options: 为每个视频维护完整计数的哈希表
排序数组加二分查找
布隆过滤器加时间戳
哈希函数映射进二维计数器数组，省内存换近似
why: CMS 用多个哈希把每次 add 落在 2D 计数阵列的格子上；不存 ID 本身所以极省内存，代价是只能近似。
why_en: A count-min sketch maps items through several hash functions into a two-dimensional counter array, remembering approximate counts in hundreds of megabytes instead of a hundred-gigabyte table.
options_en: Maintain a full hash table with an exact counter per video.
A sorted array plus binary search.
A Bloom filter combined with timestamps.
Hash into a 2D counter array, trading exactness for memory.
optionExplanations: 错。完整哈希表正是 CMS 想要替代的高内存方案。
错。排序数组不省内存，也不是 CMS 的实现方式。
错。布隆过滤器只能判断存在性，不能统计出现次数。
对。多个哈希函数映射到 2D 计数阵列，牺牲精确换省内存。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong: a full hash table is exactly the high-memory approach CMS replaces.
Wrong: a sorted array doesn't save memory and isn't how CMS works.
Wrong: a Bloom filter only tests membership, not occurrence counts.
Correct: multiple hash functions map into a 2D counter grid, trading precision for memory.

q: 补全 CMS 的操作接口：
q_en: Fill in the CMS operation interface:
text: 传统 CMS 只支持两个操作：{{add}}(item, count) 和 {{estimate}}(item)；它没有 {{list}} 操作——add 完成的那一刻，元素的 ID 就被忘掉了。

why_en: A sketch supports only add and estimate with no list operation, which is why top-K needs a companion sorted list to remember candidate IDs.

q: CMS 的 estimate 返回值有什么性质？
q_en: What property does a CMS estimate return value have?
options: 是精确值
是真实次数的上界，也是近似值
是真实次数的下界
完全随机、不可用
why: 哈希碰撞只会往计数器里多加，所以 estimate ≥ 真实值；这正是「upper bound + decent approximation」的来源。
why_en: Hash collisions only inflate the counters, so the sketch's estimate is an upper bound on the true count and a decent approximation.
options_en: It's an exact value.
It's an upper bound on the true count, and a decent approximation.
It's a lower bound on the true count.
It's completely random and unusable.
optionExplanations: 错。CMS 本身放弃了精确性来换取省内存。
对。哈希碰撞只会让计数偏大，所以估计值是上界。
错。碰撞只会往上加，不会让计数偏小。
错。估计值虽有偏差，但仍是可用的近似值。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong: CMS deliberately gives up exactness to save memory.
Correct: hash collisions can only inflate a counter, so the estimate is an upper bound.
Wrong: collisions only add, they never make the count smaller.
Wrong: the estimate is biased but still a usable approximation.

q: 把「CMS + 有序列表」处理观看与查询的流程排成正确顺序：
q_en: Put the CMS plus ordered-list event and query flow in the correct order:
steps: 把该视频的估计观看数写入/更新到有序列表或堆
观看事件到来，add 进 CMS 更新草图
查询时直接从有序列表取前 K 返回
add 后立刻对该视频 estimate，得到近似（上界）计数
周期性截断列表——用户最多查 top 1k，全时段只需保留 1000 条
why: add → estimate → 更新有序列表 → 截断到 1000 → 查询取前 K；每个要查询的窗口都保有一份自己的 sketch 加列表。
why_en: Each view is added to the sketch, immediately estimated, pushed into a sorted list that is periodically truncated to a thousand entries, and queries simply read the top K from that list.

q: 正确的命令组合是？
q_en: Which Redis command combination is correct?
options: INCR 计数 + GET 读取 + LPUSH 进列表
PFADD + PFCOUNT + ZRANGE
INCRBY 更新草图，QUERY 估值，ZADD 写入裁剪
SETBIT + BITCOUNT + SADD
codeSample:
CMS.INCRBY views:last_hour <videoId> 1
CMS.QUERY views:last_hour <videoId>
ZADD topk:last_hour <estimate> <videoId>
# 保持榜单只留前 1000
ZREMRANGEBYRANK topk:last_hour 0 -1001

whenOtherWins: PFADD/PFCOUNT 是 HyperLogLog，适合「去重计数」（多少个不同用户），不是出现次数估计；要精确榜单则回到数据库聚合方案。
options_en: INCR to count, GET to read, LPUSH to push onto a list.
PFADD, PFCOUNT, and ZRANGE.
INCRBY updates the sketch, QUERY estimates, ZADD writes and trims.
SETBIT, BITCOUNT, and SADD.

错。PFADD/PFCOUNT 是 HyperLogLog，统计的是去重基数。
对。CMS 记草图，sorted set 维护榜单，裁剪省掉多余写入。
错。位图统计不了每个视频各自的观看数。

Wrong: PFADD/PFCOUNT is HyperLogLog, which counts distinct items, not occurrences.
Correct: CMS keeps the sketch, the sorted set keeps the leaderboard, trimming avoids wasted writes.
Wrong: bitmaps can't track each video's individual view count.

q: Redis CMS 方案的耐久性隐患是？
q_en: What durability risk does the Redis CMS design have?
options: 原地变异状态，草图与榜单可能脱节
Redis 完全不支持持久化
sorted set 无法裁剪长度
CMS 占用内存过大

why_en: Because every event mutates Redis state, a crash can leave the sketch and the sorted set inconsistent, and the append-only file cannot be mapped back to Kafka offsets.
options_en: State mutates in place, so the sketch and sorted set can drift apart.
Redis doesn't support persistence at all.
The sorted set can't be trimmed in length.
CMS uses too much memory.
optionExplanations: 对。草图与榜单可能脱节，AOF 恢复也对不上 Kafka offset。
错。Redis 的 AOF/RDB 都是持久化机制，说法不成立。
错。ZADD 加裁剪能正常维护固定长度的 sorted set。
错。CMS 恰恰是为省内存设计的，这不是它的隐患。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: the sketch and the sorted set can drift apart, and AOF recovery can't align to a Kafka offset.
Wrong: Redis does support persistence through AOF and RDB, so this claim doesn't hold.
Wrong: ZADD plus trimming keeps the sorted set at a fixed length just fine.
Wrong: CMS is specifically designed to save memory, that isn't its risk.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 的追加写日志持久化方式，重放日志来恢复数据。

Manage CMS and the list as Flink state.
Serialize the sketch and store it in Postgres.
Maintain the sketch locally on the client.

why_en: Understand the underlying high-cardinality challenge and its fix through precomputation and caching rather than memorizing which database fits, so you can reason about any specialized system.
options_en: Memorize a lookup table of which database fits which problem.
Never mention specialized databases in an interview.
Don't memorize conclusions; understand the high-cardinality issue instead.
Only study the newest released databases.

错。合理使用专用库本身没问题，关键是要懂原理。
对。理解高基数这个核心难点，专用库的适配性能现场推理。

q: TimescaleDB 怎么套到本题上？
q_en: How would TimescaleDB apply to this problem?
options: 直接存原始事件，每次查询都得全表扫描一遍
hypertable 存聚合，rollup 撑大窗口
改用它自带的全文检索功能，来查找视频
把 K 这个查询参数直接存成数据库配置项
why: TimescaleDB 是偏分析的 Postgres 扩展；单小时查询本就 O(k)，大窗口靠 continuous aggregates 维护 rollup——净效果与我们手工的每窗口表方案几乎一样，但存储结构更高效。
why_en: Model hourly aggregates as a hypertable and let continuous aggregates maintain per-window rollups indexed on views so top-K reads stay order of K.
whenOtherWins: 没有 rollup 时大窗口查询用不上小时表的索引——60 份有序列表相加取前 K 无从下手；若不用 continuous aggregates，普通时序 hypertable 解决不了本题。
options_en: Store raw events directly and full-scan the whole table on every single query.
Hypertable for aggregates, rollups for large windows.
Switch over to its built-in full-text search feature to look up videos.
Store K, a query parameter, straight into the database configuration.
optionExplanations: 错。存原始事件现场全表扫描违背了几十毫秒的 SLA。
对。hypertable 存小时聚合，物化视图式 rollup 撑大窗口。
错。全文检索和求 Top-K 观看数没有关系。
错。K 是查询参数，不该固化成数据库配置。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong: storing raw events and full-scanning at query time violates the tens-of-milliseconds SLA.
Correct: hypertables hold hourly aggregates, and continuous aggregates maintain the rollups.
Wrong: full-text search is unrelated to computing top-K view counts.
Wrong: K is a query parameter, it shouldn't be baked into database configuration.
tradeoff: TimescaleDB 内建 rollup vs 手工维护每窗口聚合表

termDefinitions.meaning: TimescaleDB 的分区表抽象，按时间自动切分底层分片。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hypertable is TimescaleDB's partitioned-table abstraction that automatically splits data into time-based chunks.

termDefinitions.meaning: TimescaleDB 的自动维护物化视图，持续增量更新 rollup 结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A continuous aggregate is TimescaleDB's auto-maintained materialized view that incrementally keeps rollup results fresh.

q: 即便用上 TimescaleDB，仍然绕不开的两件事是？

放弃精确性和放弃窗口功能
还得靠缓存保 SLA，还得继续分片
重写成 NoSQL 和引入新消息队列

why_en: Even with TimescaleDB you still need the cache to meet the latency SLA and the same sharding to absorb writes, since pre-aggregation is not free.
options_en: Changing programming language and changing cloud vendor.
Giving up precision and giving up window support.
Caching for the SLA, and sharding since write load hasn't gone away.
Rewriting into NoSQL and adding a new message queue.
optionExplanations: 错。语言和云厂商不是这里讨论的问题。
错。TimescaleDB 方案依旧精确且支持窗口。
对。预聚合仍要算力，写入量也没消失，缓存和分片都还需要。
错。没有必要换成 NoSQL 或引入新消息队列。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong: language and cloud vendor aren't what's being discussed here.
Wrong: the TimescaleDB approach remains precise and still supports windows.
Correct: pre-aggregation still costs compute and the write volume hasn't gone away, so caching and sharding remain.
Wrong: there's no need to switch to NoSQL or add a new message queue.
scenario: 改用 TimescaleDB 的 continuous aggregates 后，读 SLA 仍是几十毫秒、写仍是 700k TPS。
scenario_en: Even after switching to TimescaleDB continuous aggregates, the read SLA is still tens of milliseconds and writes are still 700k per second.

q: 三个实时 OLAP 系统各自的预聚合方式，以下描述正确的有？（多选）
q_en: Which real-time OLAP pre-aggregation statements are correct?
options: Druid：摄取时按时间桶 + videoId 做 rollup，段里存预求和的行；后台 compaction 可把旧数据重新汇总成更粗粒度以加速长窗口查询
Pinot：star-tree 索引与物化视图做预聚合，对固定形态的「按 videoId 取窗口 top-K」能剪掉大部分数据快速服务 GROUP BY ... ORDER BY ... LIMIT K
ClickHouse：物化视图写入 SummingMergeTree/AggregatingMergeTree，在摄取时维护分钟/时/天 rollup（压力转到写侧），固定窗口查询直接读 rollup 表
三者都不支持摄取时预聚合
why: 三者都把时间桶 + videoId 预聚合放到写侧，读固定窗口只扫 rollup 取前 K。代价是写侧更重。
why_en: All three pre-aggregate at ingest, so fixed-window top-K reads hit rollups instead of raw rows, with heavier writes.
tradeoff: 写侧预聚合成本 vs 固定窗口低延迟查询
options_en: Druid rolls up by time bucket and videoId during ingest, stores pre-summed rows in segments, and can compact old data into coarser grains.
Pinot uses star-tree indexes and materialized views to pre-aggregate, so fixed top-K-by-videoId queries can prune most rows before GROUP BY.
ClickHouse uses materialized views into SummingMergeTree or AggregatingMergeTree tables, keeping minute, hour, and day rollups on the write path.
None of the three support pre-aggregation at ingest.
optionExplanations: 对。Druid 摄取时按时间桶和 videoId rollup，后台再压缩粗化。
对。Pinot 用 star-tree 剪枝，快速服务固定形态的 group by。
对。ClickHouse 用物化视图写 MergeTree 家族表做摄取时 rollup。
错。三者都在摄取时做预聚合，这个说法与事实相反。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: Druid rolls up by time bucket and videoId at ingest, with background compaction for coarser grains.
Correct: Pinot's star-tree indexes prune data to quickly serve fixed-shape group-by queries.
Correct: ClickHouse uses materialized views into MergeTree-family tables for ingest-time rollups.
Wrong: all three do pre-aggregate at ingest, this statement is the opposite of true.

termDefinitions.meaning: Online Analytical Processing（OLAP）：面向聚合、分组、排序这类分析查询的存储和查询系统。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: OLAP means Online Analytical Processing, a storage and query style optimized for analytical aggregation, grouping, and ranking.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把明细事件按时间桶、维度或层级提前汇总成更少的行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A rollup pre-aggregates raw events into fewer rows by time bucket, dimension, or hierarchy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 后台把旧数据文件重写合并，常顺手做更粗粒度汇总。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Compaction rewrites and merges older data files in the background, often into coarser aggregates.

termDefinitions.meaning: Pinot 的预聚合索引结构，能按固定维度提前存部分聚合结果并剪枝。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A star-tree index is Pinot's pre-aggregation structure that stores partial aggregates and prunes fixed-shape queries.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预先算好并存储的查询结果，读的时候不用重新计算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A materialized view stores a precomputed query result so reads do not need to recompute it.

termDefinitions.meaning: ClickHouse 表引擎，合并相同主键行时会把数值列求和。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SummingMergeTree is a ClickHouse table engine that sums numeric columns when rows with the same key are merged.

termDefinitions.meaning: ClickHouse 表引擎，保存聚合函数状态并在后台合并这些状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: AggregatingMergeTree is a ClickHouse table engine that stores aggregate-function states and merges them in the background.

scenario: 窗口固定为小时/天/月，因此可以把 videoId + 时间桶的预聚合搬到摄取时完成。
scenario_en: Windows are fixed at hour, day, and month, so the video-id-by-time-bucket pre-aggregation can move to ingest time.

错。许可证费用不是文章强调的主要风险。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: production systems at this scale can still misbehave, and interviews expect a detailed ingestion walkthrough.

q: 「好的 TimescaleDB 方案长得和我们手工构建的方案几乎一样」揭示了什么设计哲学？

这只是巧合
手工方案太原始，应该淘汰
最自然表达理想数据流的设计最正确
why: 先想清理想数据流（摄取时聚合、每窗口一份带索引的 rollup、缓存服务读），工具只是表达方式——手工与专用库最终收敛到同一形态。
why_en: The right design is usually whatever most naturally expresses the ideal data flow, which is why the hand-built and TimescaleDB solutions converge.
options_en: Specialized databases have no value at all.
It's just a coincidence.
The hand-built approach is too primitive and should be phased out.
The design that most naturally expresses the ideal data flow is usually correct.
optionExplanations: 错。专用库确实带来更高效的存储结构，不是没有价值。
错。两者形态相似是因为解决同一个数据流问题，不是巧合。
错。手工方案不是要淘汰的对象，它揭示的是同一套理想数据流。
对。想清数据流后，工具只是表达方式，实现会殊途同归。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong: specialized databases do bring a more efficient storage structure, so they aren't valueless.
Wrong: the resemblance isn't a coincidence, both solve the same data-flow problem.
Wrong: the hand-built approach isn't obsolete, it reveals the same ideal data flow.
Correct: once the data flow is clear, tools are just an expression of it, so implementations converge.
scenario: 手工方案最终形态是「摄取时聚合 + 每窗口 rollup + 缓存读」，TimescaleDB 方案长得几乎一样。
scenario_en: The hand-built design ends up as aggregate on ingest, one rollup per window, and serve reads from cache, and the TimescaleDB design looks almost identical.
